executive_summary: Maven compilation failed with 45 errors due to persistent missing dependencies. Despite multiple build attempts, the same critical dependencies remain absent: Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, Jakarta Persistence, and Apache Commons Lang3. The pom.xml has not been updated to include these required dependencies across all three attempts.

errors.message: Missing Spring Security dependencies: packages org.springframework.security.* do not exist
errors.root_cause: Spring Security starter dependency has not been added to pom.xml after three build attempts. The SecurityConfig class requires Spring Security packages for HttpSecurity, SecurityFilterChain, and EnableWebSecurity annotations.

errors.message: Missing Spring Data JPA dependencies: packages org.springframework.data.* do not exist
errors.root_cause: Spring Data JPA starter dependency has not been added to pom.xml after three build attempts. Repository interfaces (ColumnRepository, TaskRepository, UserRepository) and controllers (TaskManagementController, UserTaskController) require Spring Data JPA packages for JpaRepository, Page, Pageable, Query, Modifying, and Param annotations.

errors.message: Missing Jakarta Persistence dependency: package jakarta.persistence does not exist
errors.root_cause: Jakarta Persistence API remains unavailable after three build attempts. Entity class BoardColumn requires JPA annotations (@Entity, @Table, @Id, @Column, @GeneratedValue, @ManyToOne, @JoinColumn) which are part of jakarta.persistence package.
errors.fix_recommendation: Jakarta Persistence is typically included with spring-boot-starter-data-jpa. Ensure spring-boot-starter-data-jpa dependency is added to pom.xml as it transitively includes jakarta.persistence-api.

errors.message: Missing Apache Commons Lang3 dependency: package org.apache.commons.lang3 does not exist
errors.root_cause: Apache Commons Lang3 library has not been added to pom.xml after three build attempts. ValidationUtils class requires StringUtils or other utilities from commons-lang3.

summary: 4 dependency errors found causing 45 compilation failures
